## Quick Summary

Khwaja Hussain Shaikh is a Full Stack Developer from Mumbai, India. He specialises in
the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js) and Next.js. He has built 8+
live production websites for real clients, won the Tech Shaastra Hackathon in both 2024
and 2025, graduated as Department Topper (BCA, CGPA 8.30) from Tilak Maharashtra
Vidyapeeth, and is currently employed full-time at ZAR Luxury Pvt. Ltd., Mumbai.
He is available for freelance projects and remote work worldwide.

## Projects (8 Live Production Websites)

### 1. Queryly — AI-Powered Q&A Platform
- Live URL: https://queryly.vercel.app/
- Stack: React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, JWT, Ant Design
- Description: Full-stack Q&A / knowledge-sharing platform (Quora-style) with Google and
  email authentication, role-based access control, user profiles, likes, and comments.
  Supports 40+ beta users.

### 2. CodeMind AI — AI-Assisted Bug Investigation for GitHub Repositories
- Live URL: https://codemind-ai-rho.vercel.app/login
- Details: https://khwajashaikh.vercel.app/projects/codemind-ai
- Stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Prisma, PostgreSQL, GitHub App, Ant Design, Tailwind CSS
- Description: Evidence-driven engineering platform that investigates a bug in a GitHub
  repository step by step (problem, evidence, hypotheses, root cause, fix, validation) before
  AI is involved, with human approval before any pull request.
- Key features:
  * Evidence gathering from the repository (text, symbols, files, dependencies, git, vector search)
    before the AI step; human approval before any pull request.
  * Secure sign-in: scrypt-hashed passwords, random session tokens in HttpOnly cookies.
  * GitHub App integration; GitHub tokens encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM).
  * Forgot-password flow with email OTP: a 6-digit one-time code sent through Google SMTP
    (Nodemailer); expires in 10 minutes, single use, burned after 5 wrong guesses, only a keyed
    hash stored; identical response whether or not the account exists; a successful reset signs
    the user out everywhere; resends are cooldown- and rate-limited.

### 2b. FinalYear Labs — Final-Year Project Platform for Students
- Live URL: https://finalyear-labs.vercel.app/
- Details: https://khwajashaikh.vercel.app/projects/finalyear-labs
- Description: Platform where BCA, MCA, BSc IT and B.Tech students find a final-year project,
  preview the live demo, and get source code, report and PPT help, viva preparation and
  WhatsApp support, with category browsing, project search and custom-project requests.

### 3. Space One Surfaces — Premium Surface Solutions Platform
- Live URL: https://spaceonesurfaces.com/
- Stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, MongoDB, Cloudflare R2, GSAP, Tailwind CSS, JWT
- Description: Full-stack brand website for a premium laminates & veneers company.
  Features a dynamic product catalog with 4 collections, finish & colour browsing,
  catalogue PDF downloads, admin CMS, and a WhatsApp lead-capture flow.

### 4. Friday Charm — Fashion & Lifestyle E-Commerce
